verses.text: When you sit down to eat with a ruler, pay close attention to what's in front of you.
If your appetite runs the show, put a knife to your throat.
Don't crave the fancy food. There's a catch behind what's on the plate.
Don't wear yourself out chasing money. Be wise enough to know when to stop.
Why lock your eyes on something that can vanish? Money sprouts wings like an eagle and takes off into the sky.
Don't eat food from a stingy person or get tempted by the fancy stuff they're serving.
Deep down they're counting the cost. “Go on, eat and drink!” they tell you, but their heart isn't in it.
You'll throw up what you ate, and all your nice words will have been a waste.
Don't pour wise words into a fool's ears. They'll just look down on what you say.
Don't move the ancient boundary stone or take over fields that belong to children without a father.
Their Defender is strong. He'll take up their case against you.
Put your heart into learning and give your ears to words that teach you something.
Don't hold back correction from a child. Discipline with the rod won't kill them.
Discipline them with the rod and rescue their life from the grave.
My son, if your heart gets wise, my own heart will be glad too.
I'll be cheering inside when I hear you speak what's right.
Don't let your heart get jealous of sinners. Keep standing in awe of the LORD all day long.
There's a future to look forward to, and your hope won't be cut off.
Listen, my son, and get wise. Keep your heart on the right road.
Don't hang around with people who drink too much wine or stuff themselves with meat.
Drunkards and people who gorge themselves end up poor. All that drowsiness leaves them dressed in rags.
Listen to your dad, who gave you life. Don't look down on your mom when she gets old.
Buy the truth and don't sell it. Get wisdom, discipline, and understanding.
A father is overjoyed when his child does right. Raising a wise child brings him real delight.
Give your dad and mom a reason to be glad! Let the woman who gave birth to you celebrate!
My son, give me your heart and keep watching the way I walk.
A prostitute is a deep pit, and a wife who's straying is a narrow well.
She lies in wait like a robber and draws more men into breaking their vows.
Who's miserable? Who's hurting? Who's fighting and complaining? Who's got bruises for no reason and eyes all bloodshot?
It's people who stay up drinking wine and go looking for another mix.
Don't stare at the wine when it's red and sparkling in the cup, sliding down so smoothly.
In the end it bites like a snake and injects venom like a viper.
You'll see strange things and your mind will come up with all kinds of confusion.
You'll feel like you're lying down in the middle of the sea or stretched out at the top of a ship's rigging.
“They hit me, but it didn't hurt! They beat me, and I didn't feel it! When am I going to wake up? I'll do it again. I'm going to find more.”
